name: Teleporting Strike
body:
School conjuration (teleportation); Level sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target you
Duration see text
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You momentarily whisk yourself off to another location within range, returning to your previous location seconds later. Upon casting this spell, you instantaneously appear anywhere within the spell’s range. You have enough time to perform a single standard action before you are transported back to where you were when you cast the spell. Teleporting into a threatened square does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
